answer: Asynchronous Burst Inter-Arrival Shaping. Agents transmit validation frames only when responding to asynchronous network pulses originating from a physical weather station in the tundra. An attacker spawning ten thousand sybil nodes causes a severe bandwidth bottleneck along the main routing river, dropping their packet delivery ratio below ten percent. Furthermore, the system challenges a stray raven query to each node every two hours; failure to reply within a tight two-millisecond window permanently drops the identity.
